title: PeriodExtendedPayload
description: Payload of the PeriodExtended event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: domain). Authored by INV-T-2853 (T9). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

entityRef.description: The registered entity the extension applies to.

target.description: Which due date the extension moves.

newFilingDueDate.description: New absolute filing due date, present when target includes FILING_DUE_DATE.

newSubmissionDueDate.description: New absolute submission due date, present when target includes SUBMISSION_DUE_DATE.

documentRefs.description: Doc UUIDs in scope, present when kind is DOCUMENT_SET.

dateFrom.description: Range start, present when kind is DATE_RANGE.

dateTo.description: Range end, present when kind is DATE_RANGE.
